battle.name: 魏勝抗金起義
battle.theater: 淮南東路和州與采石江口
battle.brief: 隆興元年金主完顏亮御駕親征，淮南諸州相繼淪陷，鄉兵首領魏勝舉兵響應，收復和州、滁州，遊擊於淮東。金軍自瓜洲架浮橋十餘里直逼采石，虞允文督軍督戰，魏勝部曲以弓弩火箭並進，焚燒浮橋，金軍南侵之謀遂敗。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 交戰的雙方是金國與南宋。金方由海陵王完顏亮御駕親征：隆興元年他自中都出發，率中樞主力經河南、汴梁一線南下，另分偏師趨襄漢、由齊魯趨兩淮，渡淮之後御營駐泗州、楚州一線，指揮系統仍以女真猛安謀克為骨幹，雜以契丹、漢軍及新附的偽齊軍；攻城序列裡配的是飛石、雲梯、攻城槌與木構浮橋，糧秣靠黃河與淮水漕運以及就地徵發，佔領的州縣則以歸降的漢官治理。南宋方面，朝廷在淮西只剩楚州、濠州、和州幾處城防與沿江烽燧，禁軍主力被抽去跟隨張浚北伐，淮南的守備落到鄉兵、寨兵與義軍手上，這一點在隆興元年上半年就已顯得空虛。魏勝正是趁這個空隙聚眾起兵：他以淮東鄉兵原有的編制為骨架，練出以弓弩手為主的隊伍，自號忠義軍，據和州、滁州、定遠一線的山寨與村堡，避開金軍騎兵的鋒頭，以遊擊方式斷其糧道、收復失地，同時接受南宋朝廷的名義授職與部分糧械接濟。義軍與朝廷的關係始終疏鬆：朝廷需要淮南前線分擔金軍壓力，卻沒有兵力派人接管；義軍靠地方糧源自給，長期在金軍佔領區與宋軍防區之間游走。最後的決定性一仗發生在隆興元年十一月采石：虞允文以中書舍人奉命督視軍務，節制沿江諸軍，魏勝部曲與兩淮各州趕到的援軍並肩作戰，金軍浮橋被焚，南侵之計破產。金主亮退回兩淮，旋於瓜洲渡為自己人所殺，其弟完顏元宜即位，是為金世宗，金廷隨即轉向對宋用和，隆興二年和議成，義軍失去戰爭對象，逐步被收編或解散。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Jin dynasty and the Southern Song. On the Jin side the host was led personally by the Prince of Hailing, Wanyan Liang: in the first year of Longxing he set out from Zhongdu with the main body of the central command down the Henan and Bianjing road, while detached columns were sent toward Xiangyang and against the two Huai through Shandong and the north, and once across the river his imperial camp stood on the line of Si and Chu; the chain of command still rested on the Jurchen meng'an mouke as its backbone, mixed with Khitan, Han troops and the newly absorbed army of the puppet state of Qi. The siege train carried stone-throwers, scaling ladders, battering rams and timber-built floating bridges; food and fodder came by the Yellow River and the Huai waterways and by requisition on the spot, and the occupied prefectures were administered by surrendered Han officials. On the Song side the court still held only the walled posts of Chu, Hao and He in western Huai and the beacon towers along the river; the main body of the imperial guards had been drawn off to follow Zhang Jun on the northern expedition, and the defence of Huai fell to village militia, fortified villages and volunteers, a point already glaringly visible in the first half of the first year of Longxing. Wei Sheng moved precisely into that gap. He took the existing organisation of the Huai-dong village militia as his skeleton, drilled a force whose backbone was crossbowmen, called it the Army of Loyalty and Righteousness, and based himself on the stockades and village strongholds of the He, Chu and Dingyuan line, staying out of the way of Jin cavalry and recovering lost ground by harassment while cutting the enemy's supply lines, and accepting the Song court's nominal appointment and part of its grain and weapons. The relationship between the volunteers and the court was never close: the court needed a Huai front to take part of the Jin pressure but had no troops to take over command, and the volunteers fed themselves from local stores, moving for months between the Jin-occupied zone and the Song defensive zone. The decisive action came at Caishi in the eleventh month of the first year of Longxing. Yu Yunwen, a director of the Central Secretariat, was sent to supervise the Caishi forces, took command of the riverside units, and Wei Sheng's men fought shoulder to shoulder with the reinforcements from the prefectures of the two Huai; the Jin floating bridge was burned and the plan of the southern invasion collapsed. Wanyan Liang fell back to the two Huai and was shortly killed by his own men at the Guazhou crossing; his brother Wanyan Xuanyi succeeded him as Emperor Shizong, the Jin court turned at once to a policy of peace with Song, and when the peace settlement of the second year of Longxing was concluded the volunteers lost the war for which they had risen and were gradually absorbed into the army or dispersed.
people: 關鍵人物橫跨金宋兩朝。魏勝是這場起義的核心。他原是淮南邊防的基層軍官，與鄉兵、獵戶相熟，長於用弓騎，金兵渡淮之後見官軍節節退守、州縣相繼淪陷，便聚起一支以弓弩手為骨幹的鄉兵，自號忠義軍，據和州、滁州一帶收復失地；他的特色是練射不懈，據說隊中人人心以弓弩為業，白日在田間耕作、夜間校射，這使義軍在沒有重甲、沒有攻城器械的條件下，仍能在村落與山寨之間跟金軍騎兵周旋。采石之戰時他率部曲歸虞允文節制，成為江防左翼的一支主力。虞允文是這場戰役的關鍵中樞：隆興元年十一月他以中書舍人奉命督視采石軍務，到軍之日士氣已潰、軍器不足以封住浮橋，他整頓散卒、重排弩陣、統一旗鼓訊號，才把這支臨時湊起來的隊伍變成能打的陣勢。完顏亮是反面的一端：他以新近完成宮廷政變之君的身份傾國南征，決心滅宋，渡江失利後又斬將以謝眾、屢加重罰，終於在瓜洲渡為自己人所殺；涉入其事的是完顏元宜，他隨後即位，是為金世宗，這場政變把金廷的對宋政策從攻擊轉為守成。南宋方面，隆興元年北伐的主帥張浚屢攻不下、士氣崩潰而退，丞相湯思退等主張議和，隆興二年和議因此成立；同一時期江西也響應起義，辛棄疾以數十人夜渡軍營，生擒叛將張安國送往臨安，可見義軍並非孤例。南宋水軍主將李寶同年攻楚州失利，舟師為金軍所獲，江防力量一時更加單薄。
peopleEn: The key figures span both courts. Wei Sheng was the heart of the rising. He was originally a junior officer of the Huai frontier defences, at home with the village militia and the hunters, and skilled with bow and horse; when, after the Jin crossed the river, he saw the official troops fall back step by step and the prefectures fall one after another, he gathered a force of village militia whose backbone was crossbowmen, named it the Army of Loyalty and Righteousness, and based himself in He and Chu recovering lost ground. His hallmark was unremitting drill with the bow: the men of the band, it is said, all took the crossbow as their trade, shooting by night after working the fields by day, and that discipline let a force with neither heavy armour nor siege engines move among the villages and stockades and match Jin cavalry on their own terms. At the battle of Caishi he brought his men under Yu Yunwen's command as a main body on the left of the river defences. Yu Yunwen was the hinge of the campaign: in the eleventh month of the first year of Longxing he was sent to supervise the Caishi forces, and when he arrived the troops were already breaking up and the ordnance was not enough to seal the floating bridge; he rallied the stragglers, reordered the crossbow ranks and unified the signalling of flags and drums, and only then did a force hastily gathered become an army that could fight. Wanyan Liang is the other end of the story. A ruler who had come to the throne through a palace coup, he invaded the south with the whole state behind him and was set on destroying Song; when the crossing failed he had generals executed to answer for it and piled on punishments, and was finally killed by his own men at Guazhou. Wanyan Xuanyi was drawn into the affair and then succeeded him as Emperor Shizong, and the coup turned the Jin policy towards Song from attack to defence. On the Song side Zhang Jun, commander of the northern expedition of the first year of Longxing, hammered fruitlessly at the enemy, saw his troops' morale collapse and withdrew; chancellor Tang Situi and others pressed for negotiations, and the peace of the second year of Longxing followed from that. In the same years Jiangxi also answered the rising: Xin Qiji with a few dozen men rode through the night to seize the rebel general Zhang Anguo and send him to Lin'an, which shows the volunteers were no isolated case. The Song admiral Li Bao attacked Chu with his flotilla in the same year and was beaten, his ships being taken by the Jin, which left the river defences even thinner.
kits: 這張卡上的兵器是希臘火，但魏勝的隊伍裡沒有拜占庭的銅管噴火器；牠在這場戰爭裡的位置，是作為火攻技術的祖型，而真正落到義軍手上的，是它的中國近親——猛火油與火箭。希臘火的做法是以銅管或虹吸把混有石灰與瀝青的燃燒劑噴出，點燃後附著在船帆與板木上燒個不停，用來封鎖登陸點、燒毀攻城塔與浮橋；最著名的一次在七百年代君士坦丁堡圍城戰中，圍城的阿拉伯艦隊被燒成火海。此後拜占庭把它用於海戰封鎖，也傳入伊斯蘭世界，再由西亞與印度洋的航路把以石油縱火的用法帶到中國，宋代兵書中的猛火油即是同一思路的中文表述。《武經總要》所載的猛火油盛在陶罐裡，用煙砲把燃燒的油罐射上城垛或敵船，另配蘸油火箭，另有皮囊盛油供人拋擲；在火藥兵器成熟之前，這是攻守雙方唯一可靠地燒毀大型木構器械的手段。放到隆興元年采石戰場，這個邏輯原封不動地重演：金軍用浮橋把十餘里長的木排與船隻連成一體，橋面、支柱與船帆皆為易燃之處，義軍與官軍的火箭手、火砲手就是靠火攻去燒橋斷索，而不是去撞它。除火攻之外，義軍的真正主力是弓弩：鄉兵自備弓、矢與皮甲，步卒居中，騎兵只擔任偵察與追擊；宋軍的弩機有臂弩、床子弩與能穿重甲的神臂弓，一次齊射可以壓住城頭與浮橋上的金兵。金軍方面的攻城裝備是飛石、雲梯、攻城槌與浮橋，攻城塔多以濕氈覆頂以防火攻；兩軍的糧秣一半靠官道與漕運，一半靠就地徵發，義軍的補給尤其仰賴鄉村的藏糧。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is Greek fire, but Wei Sheng's band had no Byzantine bronze siphon; its place in this war is as the ancestor of the technique of fire attack, and what actually reached the volunteers was its Chinese near relative, mineral oil and fire arrows. Greek fire was made by forcing a burning mixture of lime and pitch out through a bronze pipe or siphon so that it stuck to sails and planking and kept burning, used to seal a landing place and to burn down assault towers and floating bridges; the most famous occasion was the siege of Constantinople in the seventh century, when the besieging Arab fleet was burned to a sheet of flame. The Byzantines afterwards used it in naval actions to seal the sea, and it passed into the Islamic world, and from there the practice of setting fires with petroleum travelled to China by the routes of western Asia and the Indian Ocean; the mineral oil of the Song military manuals is the same idea written in Chinese. The Wujing Zongyao describes mineral oil carried in earthenware jars, fired at walls and enemy ships with a smoke bomb that shoots a burning jar, with oil-dipped fire arrows used alongside, and further oil kept in leather bags to be thrown by hand; before gunpowder weapons matured, this was the only reliable means of either side to burn down large timber structures. On the battlefield of Caishi in the first year of Longxing the same logic was played out unchanged: the Jin had joined a timber raft and a line of vessels into a floating bridge over ten li long, and the deck, the uprights and the sails were all highly inflammable, so the fire-arrow men and the artillery of the volunteers and the regulars broke the bridge and cut its cables by fire rather than by ramming it. Apart from fire, the real strength of the volunteers was the bow and the crossbow: the village men carried their own bows, arrows and leather armour, infantry formed the body, and cavalry were used only for scouting and pursuit. The Song crossbows came in the hand crossbow, the bed crossbow on a plank and the shenbi bow that could pierce heavy armour, and a single massed volley could pin the Jin on the wall-heads and on the floating bridge. The Jin siege equipment was stone-throwers, scaling ladders, battering rams and the floating bridge, their assault towers usually roofed with wet felt against fire; both sides drew half their food from the roads and the grain traffic and half from requisition on the spot, and the volunteers depended above all on the grain hidden in the villages.
tactics: 義軍的戰法是一套在沒有城池掩護的條件下自創的鄉兵戰法。魏勝的辦法是避開金軍騎兵最擅長的開闊地帶，把據點放在山寨、村堡與河道彎曲處，多選背水或近林的位置，使金騎無法展開衝鋒；白天以少量人馬張旗誘敵、夜裡以主力襲營燒糧，遇到大股金軍則散入鄉野重新集結，避免在可能被包圍的地形上戀戰。義軍多為步卒，弓弩射擊是主要殺傷手段，陣形鬆散但射速齊整，長於在短距離內傾瀉箭雨，也善於用火箭焚燒金軍的帳幕、糧車與臨時棧橋；攻擊城邑時則以火攻配合輕裝突擊，逼迫金軍放棄據點。金軍在采石的攻法是把浮橋當成前線：自瓜洲方向以船載木排架橋直抵采石江岸，橋側護以戰船與弓弩手，試圖以橋頭堡與宋軍對射，同時在下游以雲梯、攻城塔試探登岸。金軍的優勢是騎兵、砲火與工程器械，弱點正如希臘火在君士坦丁堡所暴露的那樣——龐大的木構結構與帆布在火攻面前極為脆弱，橋一旦被燒斷，後方接應的船與兵都被一併切斷。宋軍的應對正是以火破之：據當時記錄，虞允文把兩淮各州趕到的援軍與魏勝的弓弩手編為前中後三陣，弩手壓制橋頭與護船，金軍步騎逼近時以火箭覆蓋橋面，另有敢死隊冒死攀上浮橋斫斷連接的纜索，兩面夾擊之下浮橋崩解，金軍遂退。整個過程不過一日之內，但已足以說明火攻的價值：面對比弩箭更難摧毀的工程兵器，點火比射擊有效得多。
tacticsEn: The tactics of the volunteers were a form of village fighting invented for conditions in which no walled city was available. Wei Sheng's solution was to avoid the open ground where Jin cavalry was at its best and to place his strongholds among stockades, village towers and bends of the river, choosing positions with water at the back or woods nearby so that the Jin horse could not spread out for the charge; by day a few men were shown with banners to draw the enemy in, and by night the main body fell on the camp to burn the grain, and when a large Jin force came they scattered into the countryside and re-formed, refusing to be drawn into a fight on ground where they might be surrounded. The band was mostly infantry, bow and crossbow fire was the main source of damage, the formation was loose but the rate of shooting was uniform, and they were at their best in pouring arrows over a short distance; they were also good at using fire arrows to burn Jin tents, grain carts and improvised trestles, and when they attacked a walled town they combined fire attack with a light rush to force the garrison to abandon the place. The Jin method at Caishi was to make the floating bridge into a front line: from the Guazhou side they carried timber on boats to build the bridge straight to the Caishi bank, screened it on both sides with warships and crossbowmen, and tried to exchange fire with Song troops from a bridgehead, while at the lower end they sounded the water with scaling ladders and assault towers. The Jin strength was cavalry, artillery and engineering, and the weakness was exactly what Greek fire had exposed at Constantinople: vast timber structures and canvas were extremely fragile in the face of fire, and once the bridge burned the supporting ships and the men aboard them were cut off with it. The Song answer was to break it with fire. The record of the time has Yu Yunwen drawing up the reinforcements from the prefectures of the two Huai and Wei Sheng's crossbowmen into three lines, front, centre and rear; the crossbowmen pinned the bridgehead and the screening ships, fire arrows covered the deck as the Jin foot and horse closed in, and dare-to-die parties climbed the floating bridge to hack at the cables that held it together, so that under attack from both sides the bridge fell apart and the Jin withdrew. The whole business took no more than a day, but it is enough to show the value of fire: against works of engineering that arrows could not break, setting fire was far more effective than shooting.
data: 可核對的數字不算多，但幾個節點相當確定。金主亮這次南征傾國而出，各路調集之兵以數十萬計，宋廷檔案與後世記載對總數有數十萬乃至號稱百萬的說法，採石江面實際集結的金兵亦非小數，騎兵與步卒混編在沿江十餘里上，後世常以四十萬、八十萬等數形容其傾國之勢，這些數字都應視為宣傳性的約數。浮橋的長度是較具體的一項：史載金軍在瓜洲與采石之間架浮橋十餘里，以船載木排相連，兩端各置營壘。時間線上的錨點有四個：隆興元年上半年金兵渡淮，淮南諸州相繼淪陷；同年夏秋之間，魏勝的義軍收復和州、滁州一帶；隆興元年十一月，采石之戰開打，金軍浮橋被焚；同年十二月，完顏亮在瓜洲渡被自己人所殺。戰力對比上有一件常被引用的舊事：同年宋將李寶率水軍攻楚州失利，舟師覆沒，戰船盡為金軍所得，江防力量的空虛由此可見。義軍的人數沒有明文記載，從他們能在兩州之地持續出動、夜間突擊而不被消滅推斷，應是數千至數萬之眾，其中弓弩手佔多數。隆興二年和議的條款有據可查：以淮水為界，宋每年進銀、絹各二十五萬，疆界大致回到紹興和議時的格局。魏勝其後一直留鎮兩淮，乾道年間病卒於軍中，宋廷追贈官職；史家記其死後淮西一線稍安。
dataEn: The checkable figures are not many, but several landmarks are firm. Wanyan Liang came south with the whole state behind him and the troops drawn up from every route are counted in tens of thousands; the records of the Song court and later writers give totals of several tens of thousands and even of a claimed hundred thousand, and the Jin actually assembled on the Caishi reach was no small force either, cavalry and infantry mixed along ten-odd li of the river. Later ages commonly used figures of forty thousand or eighty thousand to describe the scale of the invasion, and such numbers should be treated as approximate figures of propaganda. The length of the floating bridge is the more concrete item: the histories record that the Jin bridged the water between Guazhou and Caishi with a float over ten li long, built up on boats carrying timber, with a camp at each end. There are four anchors on the timeline: in the first half of the first year of Longxing the Jin crossed the Huai and the prefectures of Huai fell in turn; in the summer and autumn of the same year Wei Sheng's volunteers recovered He and Chu; in the eleventh month of the first year of Longxing the battle of Caishi was fought and the Jin bridge was burned; and in the twelfth month of the same year Wanyan Liang was killed by his own men at the Guazhou crossing. One often cited comparison of strength belongs to the same year: the Song admiral Li Bao attacked Chu with his flotilla and was defeated, his ships being taken by the Jin, which shows how thin the river defences were. The number of the volunteers is not recorded; from the fact that they could keep operating across two prefectures and strike at night without being destroyed, they must have numbered from some thousands to some tens of thousands, with crossbowmen in the majority. The terms of the peace of the second year of Longxing can be looked up: the Huai became the frontier, Song paid in silver and silk twenty-five thousand each per year, and the border returned broadly to the shape it had under the Shaoxing settlement. Wei Sheng stayed in the two Huai afterwards, died of illness in the army during the Qian Dao reign, and the court granted him a posthumous appointment; the historians note that the western Huai line grew quieter after his death.
cause: 這場起義的起因是隆興元年金主亮傾國南征之後，淮南前線的崩解。金主亮在皇位爭奪中清除宗室而得勢，一一六〇年即皇帝位，紹興三十一年御駕南征，戰事自河南與襄漢兩路展開，淮河很快被突破，淮南各州在半年內相繼淪陷。南宋的處境是兩頭都缺人：朝廷把主力押在張浚指揮的隆興北伐上，結果在淮北一線屢攻不下、主力損折，北伐在秋天已不成規模，朝廷轉而準備議和；正是在這個空檔，淮東一帶的州縣成了既無官軍又無實力的真空地帶。金軍的占領軍以胡漢混編的隊伍接管地方，稅賦、徵發與治安都靠臨時拼湊，民間的抵抗便以鄉兵結義的形式冒出來。魏勝的起義還有一層更深的催化：紹興和議已把淮南划在金界之外二十餘年，南人對那片土地的記憶與認同並未隨和議消失，一旦金軍以為可以長驅直入、漢人聚居區被當作征服對象，民間的抵抗立刻得到擁護。朝廷對此採取的是實用主義：需要淮南前線牽制金軍，又沒有兵力接管，遂以名分授職、少量糧械加以羈縻，讓魏勝這類武人自己打自己的仗。義軍也明白自己的處境——不求攻城略地，只求守住鄉里、拖住金軍、保持與采石江防的呼應。
causeEn: The origins of the rising lie in the collapse of the Huai front after Wanyan Liang's wholesale invasion in the first year of Longxing. Having cleared rivals from the succession, the Prince of Hailing took the throne in 1160 and launched his invasion in the thirty-first year of Shaoxing; the war opened along two roads, through Henan and through Xiangyang, the Huai was broken quickly, and the prefectures of Huai fell one after another within half a year. The Song was short of men on both fronts: the court had committed its main strength to the northern expedition under Zhang Jun, and after repeated failures north of the Huai and heavy losses the expedition had collapsed by the autumn, so the court turned to preparing negotiations. It was precisely in that gap that the prefectures of eastern Huai became a vacuum with neither government troops nor real authority in them. The Jin garrison took over the country with mixed units of different races, and taxation, requisition and order were all improvised, so resistance appeared in the form of armed village bands. Wei Sheng's rising had a deeper catalyst as well: the Shaoxing settlement had put Huai outside the Jin border for more than twenty years, and the memory and attachment of the southern people to that land did not disappear with the treaty; once the Jin thought it could drive straight through and treated the districts where Han Chinese lived as a country to be conquered, the resistance of the countryside was immediately taken up. The court's response was expedient: it needed a Huai front to hold the Jin down, had no troops to take over command, and so granted titles and a little grain and weapons to keep Wei Sheng and men like him in hand, and let them fight their own war. The volunteers understood their position: they did not aim at taking prefectures and cities, only at holding their own districts, tying the Jin down, and keeping in touch with the river defences at Caishi.
impact: 直接後果是淮南前線在金軍佔領之後沒有全部淪為無人之地，采石江防也多出一支不必等待官府調撥的武裝。義軍的存在讓金軍無法把淮南當作後方：每一次向采石方向調兵，後方都留下可供襲擊的薄弱點，金軍必須分兵護糧、護驛，推進速度因此減慢。技術上，這場戰爭把以火攻破木構工程的做法再一次擺到台面上：希臘火在拜占庭手中是一種攻城與封海用的燃燒劑，經阿拉伯人之手傳到地中海與西亞，最後以猛火油的名義進入中國的兵書，於隆興元年又以火箭與火砲的形式出現在采石江邊；它提醒後人，在火砲與火藥武器成熟之前，燃燒劑仍然是對付浮橋、攻城塔與船隊最省力的手段。義軍本身卻沒有形成制度：他們靠的是首領的信望與鄉村的糧源，沒有軍籍、沒有正式番號，也沒有能順利繼承的指揮系統，隆興二年和議一訂，和談的消息一到，維持這支武裝的理由便消失，多數人散去回鄉，魏勝仍留鎮兩淮，隨後病卒，這一線此後再沒有同等規模的鄉兵起義，直到蒙古軍南下，淮南才又成為抗爭最激烈的地方。從長遠看，隆興元年這一役成了宋金相持的轉折點：采石的敗仗加上金主亮本人的死亡，讓剛即位的金世宗明白全面南征並不可行，改以守禦與和議為主，之後數十年宋金之間維持在淮水兩岸，直至十三世紀初蒙古人改變了這個格局。
impactEn: The immediate consequence was that the Huai front did not become empty territory after the Jin occupation, and that the Caishi defences had an armed force that had not to wait for the court to send it. The existence of the volunteers meant the Jin could not treat Huai as their rear: every time they moved troops towards Caishi they left weak points behind them open to attack, and had to detach men to guard grain and the relay stations, which slowed their advance. Technologically, the war once again put the idea of breaking timber works by fire on the table: Greek fire in Byzantine hands was a burning agent for sieges and for sealing the sea, it passed through Arab hands into the Mediterranean and western Asia, and finally entered the Chinese manuals under the name of mineral oil, and in the first year of Longxing it appeared once more on the banks of the Caishi in the form of fire arrows and artillery. It reminded later generations that before gunpowder weapons matured, a burning agent remained the cheapest way to deal with floating bridges, assault towers and fleets. The volunteers themselves built no institution: they rested on the authority of their leader and on the grain of the villages, had no registers, no official designation and no command system that passed smoothly from one man to the next, and once the peace of the second year of Longxing was signed the news of the talks removed the reason for keeping such a force under arms, most of the men went home, and Wei Sheng stayed in the two Huai and died soon after. No rising of the same size appeared on that front again until the Mongols came south and Huai became once more the place where resistance was fiercest. In the long run the campaign of the first year of Longxing became the turning point in the standoff between Song and Jin: the defeat at Caishi, together with the death of the Jin ruler himself, showed the newly enthroned Shizong that a full-scale southern campaign was not workable, so he turned to defence and negotiation, and for the following decades Song and Jin held the two banks of the Huai until the Mongols changed the arrangement in the early thirteenth century.
result: 就這場起義本身而言，結果是有限的成功：魏勝收復了和州、滁州一帶的失地，把金軍在淮南的統治撕開一個口子，義軍自初起時的數千人到能持續威脅金軍的糧道與驛傳，讓金主亮無法把淮南當作可以放手南下的後方；但它沒有能力收復整個淮西，也從未打算攻取州府大城，始終是一支在鄉野之間打游擊的武裝。隆興元年十一月的采石之戰是義軍捲入的最高潮：虞允文督軍，義軍與兩淮援軍併肩作戰，火箭與火砲燒斷浮橋，金軍南侵之謀至此破產；隨即完顏亮在瓜洲渡被自己人所殺，金廷換主，新君金世宗一改攻勢，隆興二年訂下和議，以淮水為界，宋每年進銀絹各二十五萬。義軍因此失去繼續存在的理由：和議既成，恢復舊界與南下的目標都不再現實，朝廷開始收編與解散，返鄉者散去，留在編制的魏勝鎮兩淮數年，乾道年間病卒。對南宋而言，這場起義是在北伐失敗、割地議和的年份裡保住的一支自發武力；對金而言，它是一次沒有改變疆界的邊境騷擾；兩邊都沒有從中得到真正的解決，四十五年後宋金再度大戰於兩淮時，淮南的抵抗仍舊主要依靠城守與屯兵。
resultEn: As the rising itself was concerned, the result was a limited success. Wei Sheng recovered the lost ground around He and Chu, tore a gap in the Jin rule over Huai, and grew from a few hundred men at the outset into a force that could keep threatening the Jin grain lines and relay stations, so that Wanyan Liang could not treat Huai as the rear from which to advance freely. But the band could not recover the whole of western Huai, and never intended to take the prefectural cities; it remained an armed force fighting a guerrilla war among the villages and fields. The battle of Caishi in the eleventh month of the first year of Longxing was the high point of the rising: Yu Yunwen supervised the defence, the volunteers and the reinforcements from the two Huai fought shoulder to shoulder, fire arrows and artillery burned the floating bridge apart, and the plan of the Jin invasion collapsed. Then Wanyan Liang was killed by his own men at Guazhou, the Jin court changed rulers, and the new Emperor Shizong reversed the offensive; in the second year of Longxing the peace was concluded, taking the Huai as the frontier, with Song paying silver and silk twenty-five thousand each per year. The volunteers therefore lost the reason to continue: with the peace made, neither the recovery of the old border nor a further advance south was any longer a live object, and the court began to absorb and disband them, those who went home scattered, and Wei Sheng, who stayed in the army, held the two Huai for several years and died of illness during the Qian Dao reign. For the Song this rising preserved a self-raised armed force in a year of failed northern expedition, of lost territory and of negotiation; for the Jin it was a disturbance of the border that changed no line on the map. Neither side got a real solution out of it, and when Song and Jin fought over the two Huai again forty-five years later, the resistance in Huai still depended above all on walled towns and garrison troops.
